# Wellness Detox of LA

> Wellness Detox of LA is a licensed drug & alcohol detox and residential treatment center in the Los Angeles area (DHCS License #191425AP), part of the Quadrant Health Group network.

Programs: medical detox, residential inpatient treatment, dual diagnosis treatment and aftercare. Address: 625 E Phillips Blvd, Pomona, CA 91766. Phone: 866-591-0888. Admissions are available 24/7.

All URLs below are canonical. Medical content is reviewed under the editorial policy at https://wellnessdetoxla.com/editorial-policy.

## Treatment

- [Treatment Programs](https://wellnessdetoxla.com/treatment): Medical detox, residential inpatient, dual diagnosis, and aftercare — plus evidence-based therapies for a wide range of substances at Wellness Detox of LA.
- [Aftercare Program in Los Angeles](https://wellnessdetoxla.com/treatment/aftercare): Aftercare and relapse-prevention support in Los Angeles — ongoing therapy, coaching, and check-ins that help you sustain recovery after treatment.
- [Alcohol Addiction Treatment in Los Angeles](https://wellnessdetoxla.com/treatment/alcohol-addiction): Alcohol addiction treatment in Los Angeles: medically supervised detox, residential care, and dual diagnosis support from licensed clinicians.
- [Benzo Addiction Treatment in Los Angeles](https://wellnessdetoxla.com/treatment/benzo-addiction): Benzodiazepine addiction treatment in Los Angeles. Medically guided tapers for Xanax, Klonopin, Ativan, and Valium with 24/7 clinical monitoring.
- [Cocaine Addiction Treatment in Los Angeles](https://wellnessdetoxla.com/treatment/cocaine-addiction): Cocaine and crack addiction treatment in Los Angeles. Structured, evidence-based care for cravings, mood instability, and long-term recovery.
- [Alcohol & Drug Detox in Los Angeles, CA](https://wellnessdetoxla.com/treatment/detox): Safe, 24/7 medically supervised drug and alcohol detox in the Los Angeles area. Licensed clinicians manage withdrawal and prepare you for lasting recovery.
- [Dual Diagnosis Treatment in Los Angeles](https://wellnessdetoxla.com/treatment/dual-diagnosis): Integrated dual diagnosis treatment in Los Angeles for co-occurring addiction and mental health conditions such as anxiety, depression, and trauma.
- [Family Therapy for Addiction in Los Angeles](https://wellnessdetoxla.com/treatment/family-therapy): Family therapy for addiction in Los Angeles that rebuilds trust, improves communication, and strengthens the support system around lasting recovery.
- [Fentanyl Addiction Treatment in Los Angeles](https://wellnessdetoxla.com/treatment/fentanyl-addiction): Fentanyl addiction treatment in Los Angeles. Medical detox and residential care with medication-assisted treatment and 24/7 monitoring.
- [Group Therapy for Addiction in Los Angeles](https://wellnessdetoxla.com/treatment/group-therapy): Clinician-led group therapy for addiction in Los Angeles that builds peer support, accountability, and lasting recovery skills in a safe, structured setting.
- [Heroin Addiction Treatment in Los Angeles](https://wellnessdetoxla.com/treatment/heroin-addiction): Heroin addiction treatment in Los Angeles. Medically supervised detox, MAT, and residential care to manage withdrawal safely.
- [Individual Therapy for Addiction in LA](https://wellnessdetoxla.com/treatment/individual-therapy): One-on-one addiction therapy in Los Angeles using CBT, DBT, and trauma-informed care to address the root causes of substance use and build coping skills.
- [Meth Addiction Treatment in Los Angeles](https://wellnessdetoxla.com/treatment/meth-addiction): Methamphetamine addiction treatment in Los Angeles. Psychiatric monitoring, craving management, and residential care for meth recovery.
- [Opioid Addiction Treatment in Los Angeles](https://wellnessdetoxla.com/treatment/opioid-addiction): Opioid addiction treatment in Los Angeles for prescription and illicit opioids. Medical detox, MAT, and residential care with 24/7 support.
- [Prescription Drug Rehab in Los Angeles](https://wellnessdetoxla.com/treatment/prescription-drug-addiction): Prescription drug addiction treatment in Los Angeles. Discreet, medically managed detox and residential care for opioid, benzo, and stimulant misuse.
- [Residential Inpatient Rehab in Los Angeles](https://wellnessdetoxla.com/treatment/residential): Residential inpatient addiction treatment in Los Angeles with 24/7 clinical care, evidence-based therapy, and a structured, home-like environment for recovery.
